screen: Rules — three directions on Northside's own file (second pass, 28 October 2026)
job: Where a dealer says what may be sold with what, in English, and sees it enforced: writing a rule changes what the configurator refuses on the next pick, with the rule's own because. Drawn on the seed as it stands today and in the app's day tokens: Northside has written 0 rules and no quote stands; the price list holds to 7 pairing rules measured on the workbook (F8 581 of 581, F9 530 of 530, A1 1,424 of 1,424, A2 685 of 757, F6 3,902 of 3,905, F15 555 of 571, A3 3,890 of 4,017) and follows 3 nobody wrote (F7 7,830 of 7,830, F16 1,576 of 1,576, F12 1,196 of 1,196); discover() reads 39 more patterns off 53 tables and 15,691 rows. The sentence drawn being written is the e2e walk's own: 'When the boat's steering is tiller, the motor's controls must be Tiller handle', because 'a tiller boat has no helm to steer a remote motor from'. pairReach on the loaded pack gives it 61 of 289 boats (Stacer 29, Highfield 29, Formosa 2, Stabicraft 1), 171 of 241 motors refused, the 32 ePropulsion unread (no controls written), and 45 of the 540 offers the price list makes for those boats taken away: the Highfield Classic 340, 360, 380, 360 LS and 380 LS each lose the Yamaha F25SWTC, a Remote mech motor. No history is drawn because the build keeps none; no photograph because nothing in the seed pictures a rule. The earlier first-pass boards (the sentence, the subjects, the screener) were replaced in this folder; they remain in git.

directions.name: A · The house rules — a document with a margin
directions.axis: Order by subject, then clause, then margin. One landscape paper sheet: section names hang at the left (Trailers, Motors, Rigging), the price list's rules are numbered clauses at a 580px measure with their measured figures beside them, and Northside's new rule is typed at a cursor at the end of its section as 2.4, its verb pressed open in place (refuses · warns · is off). The outer margin carries only two things: what 2.4 would reach, counted before Add, and the price list's unwritten F7 as a boxed question with numbered answers (1 Say it as Northside's · 2 Leave it noticed).
directions.only: The rules read as one page Northside could print and sign, and the machine's noticing never writes into the text: it asks in the margin, and nothing enters until a person answers.

directions.name: B · The reach — one rule against the whole price list
directions.axis: Order by consequence: reach first, the sentence small at the head, the act last. One plate holds every boat model (289, in maker rows, in the price list's own order) and every motor (241) as a mark: lit where the rule is about the boat, carmine-ringed where it takes an offer away (the five Highfield Classics), struck where the motor is refused, dashed where the file writes nothing the rule can read (the 32 ePropulsion). Under it the census between hairlines, the sale it costs, and both scopes named before the act: from the next pick, and the quotes standing now (none).
directions.only: A rule's whole consequence on Northside's own file in one look before it is on, including what it cannot read and therefore never refuses.

directions.name: C · The spine — the rules in the order of who said them
directions.axis: Order by authority, read as a route: 'A boat is picked', then the price list's 7 (folded to two), then Northside's own with the sentence being written, then the 3 noticed in a dashed node that may only warn, ending on 'Everything else your price list pairs is offered'. A + on each joint writes a rule there. The draft is drawn switched off: its state is a word of the line ('This rule [is off]'), the node keeps full ink, and the spine bends round it with 'The build passes it while it is off'. B's field is grafted into the node as a strip a maker a line, with the three figures beside it.
directions.only: Why a motor is or is not offered becomes a path read top to bottom, and off is drawn as the path going round a rule that is still whole.
